public_structural_teacher: Determine the two 9+9 cross-component bridges using only the full 72-edge public graph (never private source tags or future query). This full-public teacher is offline-training only.
frozen_rank_objective: U(after,event)= (4 if event is 9+9 public bridge else -1)*I(lossless exact event retained after) + I(after is frozen F60 causal successor) + 0.25 * sum(min(record_hops,4)^2)/16
candidate_labels: For each source-valid causal candidate differing from F60 selected successor, use clipped U(candidate)-U(F60) in [-1,1], and use fixed 16-dim candidate feature delta from source.
training: Three chronological epochs of tanh regression with SGD learning rate 0.02, no per-outcome model search; multiply every genuine public 9+9-bridge training example's gradient by 16 relative to ordinary examples; signed-int8 weights via clamp(round(w*16),-127,127). No synthetic reweighting after outcomes.
